title: Work Breakdown
description: Decomposition §4b. Main's proposed split of one approved idea into atomic, dependency-ordered child tracks. STRUCTURAL shape only — the honesty checks (exact-partition coverage, dependency closure, acyclicity, provenance, large-child guard) are enforced by decompose_check D1-D9 reading TRUSTED records, never by this schema. complexity_derived is deliberately NOT a property: it is tool-derived from size_estimate.new_loc (display-only); additionalProperties:false forbids Main self-authoring it (design §8.1).

authored_by.description: Doer identity (D8: certifier from wrapper events must differ from this)

parent_criteria_ref.description: Advisory pointer to parent-criteria.json. The BINDING hash is in the wrapper-emitted criteria_frozen event (D1).

coverage.description: criterion_id -> owner_task_id. D2 requires this multiset to EXACTLY partition the frozen criteria set (each owned once, no drop/extra/dup).

external_inputs.description: Inputs sourced from OUTSIDE the child set. D5 accepts a requires against one of these only if its source_ref is a verified type. A bare string is rejected (source_ref must be a typed object).

canonical_id.description: Canonical output id <task_id>.<output_id>: exactly one dot separator, each segment a safe id charset (no whitespace, path text, or repeated dots). D5 splits on the dot and resolves requires->produces by EXACT match. (Codex P1 finding 1.)

source_ref.description: Accepted external-input provenance (D5 verifies structurally by `kind` then shape). Exactly one of: git, sweep-fetch, frozen-verdict. A bare string fails (type must be object).

parent_criteria_refs.description: Criterion ids this child owns. D2/D9 require these to be exactly the coverage rows whose owner_task_id == this task_id.

depends_on.description: task_ids this child depends on (D4: acyclic + no dangling).

produces.description: Canonical output ids this child produces.

requires.description: Canonical output ids this child needs (D5: each resolves to a producer in the depends_on closure OR a verified external_input).

allowed_paths.description: Binding sandbox post-build (becomes the child product-plan allowed_paths).

size_estimate.description: Advisory (Codex C2 only). complexity_derived is computed from new_loc by the tool, not authored.

allow_large.description: Main's request that this child be allowed L. Codex adjudicates (C5); if granted, a wrapper-emitted large_override is required for D7.
